observations: Opening bear leg: bars 1779840000000-1780704000000 fell from bar-0 high 2094.02 to bar-10 low 1368.42, with five consecutive lower closes (1859.02, 1813.04, 1731, 1581.32, 1568.55) and large bear ranges.
Bars 1780790400000-1787011200000 stayed two-sided inside 1512.91 (bar-30 low) to 1974.46 (bar-61 high), heavy bar overlap, small bodies, no sustained trend.
Bar 1787097600000 was the window's largest bull bar: open 1916.51, high 2293.8, low 1905.63, close 2252.16 (range 388.17, close in top ~87% of the bar).
Bars 1787184000000-1787270400000 extended to highs 2348.02 and 2771, but the second closed 2515.3 with a 255.7 upper tail (close near 43% of its 445.69 range).
Bars 1787356800000-1789603200000 traded sideways between 2357.18 (bar 1788307200000 low) and 2680 (bar 1789084800000 high) with overlapping bars and repeated two-sided closes.

Bars 1789689600000-1789948800000 advanced from open 2446.22 to high 2850, closing above the 2680 top of that 27-bar range; the last bar of the leg, 1789948800000, closed 2775.61 in the top ~64% of its 208.3 range.

Final two bars pulled back: 1789948800000 close 2752.43 and bar 1790121600000 open 2752.43, high 2786.81, low 2641.37, close 2684.16 (close near 29% of its 145.44 range), back below the 2680-2700 area.
Pullback low 2641.37 retraces about 42% of the 2358.62-2850 advance, and recent swing sequence remains 2358.62 low (bar 1789430400000) vs 2357.18 (bar 1788307200000) with a higher high at 2850.

structures.description: Opening bear leg: ten bars of lower closes from bar-0 high 2094.02 down to bar-10 low 1368.42, dominated by five consecutive large bear bars; the low was not revisited for the rest of the window.
Broad two-sided range after the bear leg, from bar-30 low 1512.91 to bar-61 high 1974.46; overlapping bars, small bodies, no clean trend bars in either direction.

Bull spike from bar 1787097600000 (open 1916.51, close 2252.16, low 1905.63) through highs 2348.02 and 2771; the spike closed the range at 1512.91-1974.46 and is the largest single-bar expansion in the window.
Post-spike trading range, 27 bars between bar 1788307200000 low 2357.18 and bar 1789084800000 high 2680; repeated overlapping bars and mid-bar closes show two-sided trading below the 2771 spike high.

Four-bar bull leg from bar 1789689600000 (open 2446.22, low 2436.87) up to the window high 2850 at bar 1789948800000, closing above the 2357.18-2680 range top; bars 1790035200000 and 1790121600000 then pulled back to 2641.37 and closed back below the 2680-2700 area, so acceptance above the range is not yet shown.

evidence_for: Two very large bull trend bars anchor the bull read: bar 1787097600000 (close 2252.16, top ~87% of range) and bar 1789948800000 (close 2775.61, top ~64% of a 208.3 range, new window high 2850).
Swing sequence since the post-spike low is up: low 2358.62 (bar 1789430400000) held just above 2357.18 (bar 1788307200000) and was followed by a higher high at 2850.

Bars 1789689600000-1789948800000 closed on progressively higher levels and closed above the 2680 top of the preceding 27-bar range, i.e. a breakout attempt at the upper boundary rather than at the lower one.
The current pullback is shallow so far: two bars and 2641.37, roughly a 42% retrace of the 2358.62-2850 leg, and far above the 2357.18 range low, so no higher low has been broken.
evidence_against: The 27 bars from 1787356800000 to 1789603200000 are a genuine trading range (2357.18-2680) with overlapping bars and no net progress, so much of the post-spike period is two-sided rather than a clean channel.

The final bar 1790121600000 closed 2684.16, near the low of its range (close ~29%), back below the 2680 range top and the 2700 high of bar 1789776000000, so the breakout above the range has no follow-through yet.
Bar 1787270400000 closed 2515.3 with a 255.7 upper tail after reaching 2771, showing sellers active near the highs; price then spent 27 bars below that high before exceeding it.

The first ~70% of the window is a bear leg to 1368.42 plus a wide 1512.91-1974.46 range; a sustained bull trend is only visible from bar 1787097600000 onward, so the bull regime rests on the newer portion of the window.
transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2850, or two consecutive closes above 2786.81 (bar 1790121600000 high), would show acceptance above the range and make the current phase spike-like rather than channel-like.

Range/failed breakout: a close below 2641.37 (bar 1790121600000 low) followed by a close below 2436.87 (bar 1789689600000 low) would return price into the 2357.18-2680 range and shift the read toward trading-range/range.
Bull-trend invalidation: a close below 2357.18 would break the range low and the higher-low sequence, re-opening a bear leg toward the 1789430400000 low area.
A sequence of overlapping bars holding between 2680 and 2850 with no new high would confirm the recent advance as a channel segment inside an increasingly range-like structure.
